Regression pin: characters that tripped sakoku in @seher-ts/sdk before the
default allowlist was introduced. All of these must be silently allowed at
the default level (no --strict).

Prompt arrow      : ❯ (U+276F)
Almost equal      : a ≈ b (U+2248)
Em dash           : range — note (U+2014)
Ellipsis          : loading… (U+2026)
Less-than-or-eq   : count ≤ 10 (U+2264)
Right arrow       : a → b (U+2192)
Accented Latin    : chōonpu naïve café Zürich São (U+014D, U+00EF, U+00E9, U+00FC, U+00E3)
ZWJ family emoji  : 👨‍👩‍👧 (U+1F468 + ZWJ + U+1F469 + ZWJ + U+1F467)
Heart with VS16   : ❤️ (U+2764 + U+FE0F)
Flag (regional)   : 🇯🇵 (U+1F1EF + U+1F1F5)
